Yes—these papers directly address synthetic data curation for LLMs. The closest match is about curation methods for synthetic data in LLM training, arguing that group-level signals are necessary because individual-level signals miss interactions among samples and can hurt downstream performance [1]. Another paper proposes online reweighting for data curation and reports better generalization than offline selection/mixing in instruction tuning and pretraining [3].

If you want generation-focused curation, there are also papers on automated synthetic dataset workflow optimization [4], bilevel offline selection plus online self-refining generation [9], and seed discovery for cultural data synthesis [8].
